name: Hanuman Sitting on Coiled Tail Throne
visual_description: Lord Hanuman seated serenely atop a tall tower of his own coiled tail inside Ravana's royal court.
usage_context: Used to express self-elevation, establishing dominance, creating your own respect when denied a seat, or unmatched boss moves.

example.top_text: WHEN THEY DON'T OFFER YOU A SEAT AT THE TABLE
example.bottom_text: SO YOU BUILD YOUR OWN THRONE

text_areas.description: Situation where someone disrespects or excludes you
Punchline about making your own path or asserting superior dominance
